documented_probe: Data-processing declaration building: the agent writes a CLI generator (/app/build_declaration.py) that validates raw transaction rows into an exact-reason validation report, aggregates valid rows by (direction, partner_country, commodity_code) with integer cents / milli-kg arithmetic, applies per-direction exemption thresholds (exactly-at-threshold included), and emits a byte-order-sorted declaration CSV. The verifier independently recomputes both outputs from the raw inputs and compares; it also executes the deliverable on a copy of the visible workdir and on three hidden workdirs (boundary aggregates exactly at and one cent below the threshold, duplicated txn_ids incl. rejected duplicates and an empty-unit commodity entry, an all-invalid file with a blank line and a multi-reason row, and an all-valid-but-exempt file yielding an empty declaration), so any hardcoded visible output fails.
notes: Medium: five pipeline stages are load-bearing (validate with six documented reason codes plus MALFORMED_ROW, aggregate with exact integer arithmetic, threshold-exempt with an explicit >= boundary, C-locale sort, stable txn_id sort of the report), the visible fixture demos every reason and an exactly-at-threshold inclusion, and the hidden cases push the boundary to the cent, duplicates, degenerate all-invalid and empty-result shapes. The verifier recomputes expected output itself from the hidden fixtures rather than storing answers. Resources are trivial; no tool breadth or pressure.
